BX-100PLUS
Alarm before burglar breaks-in!
Optex presents a new concept,                    , which offers more reliable protection and 
security options.  Especially, this is designed to protect the immediate perimeter of the building. 
Windows and roll-up doors have been secured only by magnetic contacts or glass break detectors 
so far. Now,                             protects a building’s exterior by detecting intruders before entry 
is attempted and can also provide a deterrent with a sounder before the break-in occurs.
